Resource and slide availability

50 chapters · 191 glossary terms · 256 lesson allocations · 84 existing slide decks. 74 allocated lessons have current slide files; 22 project slots need replacement decks; 160 other slots have no supplied deck.

Edition 0.49 · 2026 foundation · 2027 revisions. Counts describe supplied resources, not independent curriculum approval. Legacy console slides are not presented as current Pygame project preparation.

Where to build next

  1. Replace legacy project slides with decks aligned to the current Pygame brief and requirements.
  2. Extend Unit 2 beyond Week 5 using the established SQL sequence and database fixtures.
  3. Develop Year 12 decks around the current programming, networks and SQL lesson routes.

The textbook, focused lesson routes and workbooks remain usable without slides. New slides need content and layout review; this register does not claim that missing decks have been authored.
